title: A Salt for the Sigil Again
author: Jude Winterbourne
blurb: Yara Yarrow, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
